hypothesis: Fixing independently valid C7-invariant R(4,5;21) neighborhood and dual-neighborhood sides will turn the hard 129-variable order-7 orbit instance into small 63-variable cross-edge gluings, and at least one of 256 deterministic diverse pairs may yield a valid (5,5;43) graph.

mathematical_reduction.degree_argument: The unique fixed vertex has degree divisible by 7. Every (5,5;43) graph has degree in [18,24], so its degree must be 21 and it is adjacent to exactly three of the six 7-cycles.
mathematical_reduction.canonicalization: The six cycles may be permuted while preserving the prescribed automorphism. Therefore the three neighbor cycles may be named first and their six fixed-vertex orbit variables set true,true,true,false,false,false without loss of generality.
mathematical_reduction.side_A: The 21 neighbors must induce a K4-free, I5-free graph.
mathematical_reduction.side_B: The 21 nonneighbors must induce a K5-free, I4-free graph, represented as the complement of another K4-free, I5-free side model.

configuration.pair_rule: a=i mod 64; round=floor(i/64); b=(17*i+23+11*round) mod 64 for i=0,...,255

storage_gate.on_failure: Do not launch and do not weaken the frozen plan.

outcome_policy.SAT: Immediately materialize the full graph, replay the orbit CNF, and require both established full-graph verifiers. A dual-verified model proves R(5,5)>=44.
outcome_policy.UNSAT: Each proof-free pair decision is OBSERVED_UNSAT_UNCHECKED and makes no negative class claim.
outcome_policy.BUDGET: Budget exhaustion has no mathematical meaning.
outcome_policy.scope_warning: Failure across the sampled side pairs neither excludes the full order-7 class nor arbitrary order-43 graphs.
